title: Omission Bias
coreMove: Detect when the omission bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Omission Bias as a specific decision error around omission bias, inaction, vaccination. Traceable support includes Omission bias and pertussis vaccination.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Omission Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the omission bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
